text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day, folks! It's the second
race of the
Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Which Umamusume will step up as
today's
heroine? Let's see their glory
blossom on the
track!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
This year's Tiara tour has been dramatic,
to say
the least!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The powerhouse Vodka has left the tour.
Is she
taking the limelight with her, or
will a new star
rise in her absence?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I've entered the Japanese Oaks, just like
we
planned.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And just like we planned, I'm going to
get first
place. Then they'll all see what
I'm made of.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: As if. I'll run just like I always do.
choice_data_list: Don't put too much pressure on you...
Don't put too much pressure on you...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Even if she's not here to see it...
